blind.description: A stylized straight staircase made of rough timber with painted wood-grain textures. It features ten open/semi-open wooden steps flanked by solid planked side walls and sloped stringers/handrails. The foot of the stairs has two square newel posts topped with rounded caps, and the sides and posts are detailed with subtle round wooden pegs/bolts. The back and sides are fully enclosed with vertical wooden boarding, forming a clean triangular wedge.
blind.from_above: A neat rectangular footprint showing parallel stair treads framed by thick side railings, terminating in square post tops at both ends.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly equal in height to the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 5.5 to 6 ft tall at the top); approximately 3.5 ft wide and roughly 6 to 7 ft long.
